record_note: Synthetic patient record built around de-identified MRI reports for this workshop. History, medications, and dates other than the MRI exams are fictional. Not for clinical use.

diagnosis.primary: Non-small cell lung cancer, adenocarcinoma, with a solitary right parietal brain metastasis.

presentation.presenting_complaint: Two weeks of increasing confusion and left-sided neglect noticed by family; admitted with altered mental status.
presentation.hpi_summary: 64M with lung adenocarcinoma and a solitary right parietal brain metastasis. The metastasis kept enlarging after radiosurgery and was resected; pathology was mostly radiation necrosis with a small focus of viable tumor. Now admitted with two weeks of worsening confusion and left-sided neglect. Head CTs show vasogenic edema and midline shift; dexamethasone started on admission. MRI ordered to assess for recurrent tumor versus radiation necrosis.

active_problems: Metastatic lung adenocarcinoma with a right parietal brain metastasis, status post radiosurgery and resection.
Altered mental status and left-sided neglect.
past_medical_history: No whole-brain radiation; cranial radiation limited to radiosurgery of the right parietal metastasis.

procedures.procedure: CT-guided biopsy of a right upper lobe lung mass
Right parietal craniotomy and resection of the enhancing lesion
procedures.result: Gross total resection of the enhancing lesion. Pathology: predominantly radiation necrosis with a small focus of viable metastatic adenocarcinoma.

treatments.treatment: CyberKnife stereotactic radiosurgery to the right parietal metastasis, 27 Gy in 3 fractions

expected_post_treatment_findings: Postsurgical changes of right parietal craniotomy and resection (2017-08-17).
Treatment-related enhancement possible at the resection margin after radiosurgery (2016-10) and resection.
